notes: ACCESS ROUTE: plain direct fetch worked throughout (curl_cffi chrome131 impersonation used only to smooth over intermittent 403 rate-limiting; no WAF bypass, no proxy, no browser automation). robots.txt checked FIRST: Lumens lists ClaudeBot explicitly with 'Allow: /' plus one narrow 'Disallow: /*+*' (SFCC facet URLs, which are excluded from this extraction anyway) - no Claude block. INDEPENDENCE CHECK (brief asked for this): lumens.com is NOT a duplicate of any completed company. Platform is Salesforce Commerce Cloud (PWA Kit / Managed Runtime) with SCAPI organizationId 'f_ecom_aagm_prd', siteId 'Lumens', and Constructor.io search - a signature shared by none of the 244 companies already done. The project's other lighting specialists (S.N. 139 Pooky = Shopify, S.N. 57 Schoolhouse, S.N. 65 Rejuvenation = Williams-Sonoma platform) have entirely different catalogues and site IDs; no completed company shares this catalogue. Treated as an independent company. TAXONOMY SOURCE: the site's own mega-nav (fully server-rendered in home.html with data-nav-category/subcategory/label attributes) gives 3 levels; deeper genuine levels were recovered from (a) the CategoryTile 'sub-department' strips rendered on each hub/PLP and (b) the authoritative 'Category' (product_type) refinement, whose values are full catalogue paths such as 'Lighting > Ceiling Lights > Pendant Lighting > Mini Pendants'. product_type membership was used as the discriminator between a genuine taxonomy child and a facet re-cut: the CategoryTile strips mix real children with colour/size/feature promos (e.g. /chandeliers/black/, ?prefn1=Width&prefv1=25, 'Hardwired Wall Sconces', 'Arc Floor Lamps', 'In Stock & Ready to Ship'), and only those tiles that correspond to a product_type node were kept. Every lighting branch was traversed with no depth limit (deepest emitted level is 4: Lighting > Ceiling Lights > Pendant Lighting > Mini Pendants). QTY VERIFICATION: qty is the rendered 'N Results' header on each listing, which on this site is identical to the page's data-cnstrc-num-results attribute. Because Rule 1 flags Constructor.io totals as historically inflated, the header was exhaustion-tested on 10 categories spanning three orders of magnitude - 5, 95, 125, 300, 414, 1,475, 2,517, 3,644, 7,127 and 8,675 items. All 10 were EXACT: with pageSize 45, the last page returned exactly total-45*(pages-1) unique product tiles and the next page returned zero (e.g. /clocks/ = 45+45+35 = 125 unique tile IDs, union verified; /pendant-lighting/ page 193 = 35 tiles, page 194 = 0). So on Lumens the rendered header is trustworthy, contrary to the usual pattern. LIMITATION: the site's pagination hard-stops at 10,000 results (page 223 is the last non-empty page), so the 7 room listings above 10,000 could not themselves be exhausted; their evidence strings say so. They are reported at the site's own stated figure rather than nulled, because the counting mechanism itself was proven exact ten times over and the figures are precise, not rounded. '?viewall=true' is appended in the evidence for 5 room nodes whose bare URL renders an editorial hub instead of a grid; it was verified to be display-only (e.g. /bathroom-lighting/ and /bathroom-lighting/?viewall=true both report 10,180). RULE 0 GAINS: all 8 Lighting by Room nodes kept (Rule 0.1/0.6) alongside the full type tree, with overlap flagged on every room row - they are room-suitability re-cuts of the same 34,149-item lighting catalogue and overlap each other heavily. Bathroom Lighting, Bath & Vanity Lights, Bathroom Vanity Mirrors and Bathroom Accessories all kept (Rule 0.4). Outdoor Lighting and the whole Landscape Lighting branch kept (Rule 0.5). All 5 mirror types kept including Lighted Mirrors and Bathroom Vanity Mirrors (Rule 0.3). OVERLAP / DROPPED-AS-RE-CUT: room x type cross-listings (/dining-room-chandeliers/, /bedroom-chandeliers/, /entryway-and-foyer-chandeliers/, /living-room-wall-sconces/, /bedroom-wall-sconces/, /dining-room-wall-sconces/, /hallway-sconces-and-uplights/, /entryway-and-foyer-wall-sconces/, /bathroom-wall-sconces/ etc.) were dropped: they are pure intersections of the two trees that are BOTH already emitted in full, the site itself labels them data-facet-type='FEATURED FILTER' in the same strip as its colour facets, and they exist for only an arbitrary handful of room/type pairs. Light-source re-cuts (/led-lighting/, /led-floor-lamps/, /led-table-lamps/, /led-outdoor-lighting/, /led-track-and-monorail/) dropped as facet re-cuts. /outdoor-sconces/ (2,517) dropped as a second URL for /outdoor-wall-lights/. EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: entire Furniture department; entire Fans department including all ceiling/outdoor ceiling fans (explicit exclusion) and also wall/floor/desk/exhaust fans and fan downrods, controls and parts (appliances/hardware, not in the include list); Light Bulbs and all bulb sub-types; Dimmers, Controls & Wall Plates (146) and Outlets (33) as wiring hardware; Recessed Light Housings (193) and Recessed Lighting Parts & Accessories (25) as rough-in/wiring hardware while the visible luminaire nodes (Trims, Canless, Kits) were kept; Ceiling Light Accessories and Canopies & Transformers as wiring hardware; /cable-lighting/ (37) dropped as a genuinely mixed roll-up - titles are roughly half turnbuckles, anchors, insulated cable and transformers and half heads/pendants; Rugs, Throws & Pillows, Placemats & Runners, Towels & Bath Mats and Napkins (textiles); Wine & Bar Accessories (446) and Kitchen Accessories/Tools/Cookware (bar tools, cookware); Flatware and Serving Utensils (cutlery); Fireplaces & Accessories, Outdoor Fireplaces/Firepits, Electric Patio Heaters, Umbrellas & Stands, Mailboxes/Doorbells/Address Plaques, Bathroom Hardware, Bathroom Wastebaskets & Hampers, Home Hardware, Home Storage, Office Accessories, Display Shelves, Magazine Racks, Medicine Cabinets (bathroom storage/furniture/hardware); Holiday Decor and the whole Christmas/gift-guide slug family; Toys & Games, Pet Accessories, Personal Accessories; /coat-racks/ (34) dropped as a mixed roll-up of freestanding coat stands (furniture) and wall hooks already covered by Wall Hooks & Racks; /tabletop-accessories/ (206) not emitted as a leaf because its own product_type breakdown is 58 placemats/table runners/runner rugs (textiles) out of 206 - emitted as a parent over its two in-scope children instead. NEVER-EXTRACT rules honoured: no brand or designer pages (the site is organised heavily around them - 668 brand slugs and 411 designer slugs were enumerated from /brands/ and /designers/ and excluded, together with ~600 brand-x-category slugs such as /kichler-pendants/), no Shop All / New / Sale / Open Box / Curations / Style / Icons / Gift Guide / Designer Lens pages, no colour, size, price, style or 'Ready to Ship' filter pages.
